ver: Version counter for this screen phase node. Starts at 0. Incremented by 1 on every write.
updated_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last write to this node. Null if never written.
depends_on: Snapshot of dependency versions at the time this screen phase was last written. Format: {dep_key: ver}. Supports three key prefixes: 'project.*' (field in project.json), 'self.*' (another phase on the same screen), 'module.*' (another screen's phase).
stale: True if any dependency's current ver differs from the ver recorded in depends_on.
stale_keys: List of dependency keys whose current ver differs from the recorded ver. Empty list [] when clean.
files: Only present on 4-implement nodes. Files produced during implementation, grouped by type. Format: {backend: [...], frontend: [...], migration: [...], test: [...]}.
